'''December 2001 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Junior's Cards And Comics, Austin, Texas on 8 December 2001. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3151">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-08-austin-texas-12-08-01-worst-2nd-everd3151/ austin-texas-12-08-01-worst-2nd-ever], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 8 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-08-austin-texas-12-08-01-worst-2nd-everd3151/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Junior's Cards And Comics, Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
